programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Bing a’ cluich geama le fòn-làimhe Flop, chaneil rudan a’ dol mar bu chòir oir tha am fòn-làimhe a' briseadh nuair a tha e dol na sgeing air an làr. An àite seo innse do Flop, tha Bing ga chuir dhan bhiona. Tha e faireachdainn cho dona mun seo ach tha e ag ionnsachadh gum feum e innse mar a thachair. When Bing is playing a game with Flop’s mobile phone, he accidentally drops the mobile and it breaks. Instead of telling Flop, he throws it in the bin. He feels upset about it all and learns that it’s best to tell the truth.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Bing aig cuirm sa phàirc, tha còir aige 'n oidhch' a chrìochnachadh ach tha e air bhioran agus tha e fàs cho diùid. Ge-tà, le taic bho charaidean, tha e faighinn seachad air na duilgheadasan sin agus tha e a' seinn Òran a’ Bhogha-fhroise. When Bing is at a show in the park, he is extremely nervous as he is meant to be singing the finale. However, with help from his friends, Bing gets over all his insecurities and sings the Rainbow Song.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Tha Ben a' leughadh sgeulachd dha na h-Abadas mus tig iad dhan leabaidh. Aig deireadh na sgeòil, tha iad airson an geama fhaclan a chlcuich, 's tha Hari ga fhaighinn fhèin sa ghàrradh a' coimhead son cailleach-oidhche. Before going to bed, Ben reads Seren, Hari and Ela a story. When the story ends, the Abadas decide to play the word game and this sends Hari to a windy garden looking for an owl.

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: ‘S e latha socair a th’ ann air an eilean, latha math airson a bhith dìomhain. Tha Àtaidh, Tilidh agus Nìp a’ crochadh hamag, is tha tòrr spòrs aca a’ feuchainn ri faighinn oirre. Tha na Boga-bogadaich a’ feuchainn ri faighinn oirre cuideachd, ach tha iad air an caith suas dhan adhar is a’ dol a-mach à sealladh. Càite an deach iad? Tha Àtaidh, Tilidh agus Nìp a’ falbh a’ lorg nam Boga-bogadach. It is a lazy day on the Island. Abney, Teal and Neep put up a hammock and have a great time trying to get into it. The Poc-Pocs join in the fun but are thrown up into the air and disappear. Where have they gone? Abney, Teal and Neep go on a Poc-Poc hunt.

programme.title: ’S E Iasg a Th’Annam (I’m a Fish)
programme.desc: Ged a tha riochd caran neo-àbhaisteach air a’ Bhagan-mhara, tha e den bheachd gu bheil cuid eile ann an tha nas grainnde buileach na iad. Although the Blobfish looks rather unusual, he says that there are other fish who are even more aesthetically displeasing than him.

programme.title: Peataichean/Pets
programme.desc: Tha Eilidh NicCarmaig a’ coinneachadh ri clann agus a’ faighinn a-mach mu mar a tha iad a’ coimhead às dèidh agus a’ cluich cuide rim peataichean aig an taigh. Anns a’ phrògram seo tha Eilidh a’ cèilidh air Emily agus na coineanaich aice, Syrius agus Seumas a tha beothail agus bòidheach. Gheibh sinn a-mach barrachd mu bhith a’ coimhead às dèidh coineanaich agus mu na rudan snog is spòrsail a bhios iad a’ dèanamh còmhla. Gheibh sinn cuideachd comhairle agus fiosrachadh bho Eilidh fhèin mu bhith a’ làimhseachadh, ag oideachadh agus a’ coimhead às dèidh peataichean. Eilidh Cormack meets young children who are pet owners. Together they show, tell and share how they care for, play and interact with their pets at home. In this episode, Eilidh visits Emily and her adorable rabbits, Syrius and Seumas. We find out how to look after rabbits and about all the lovely stuff Emily, Syrius and Seumas get up to together. Eilidh also shares fun and interesting facts along with advice on looking after pets at home; including how best to handle, train and feed them.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Dòmhnall Ruadh a’ leughadh An Ròn Beag. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Janis Mackay agus a dhealbhachadh le Gabby Grant. Chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Jo NicDhòmhnaill. A bedtime story for young children. Donald Smith reads An Ròn Beag by Janis Mackay, illustrated by Gabby Grant and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald.

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Gealach na Durraige Guirme a' nochdadh, tha i a’ taladh dhurragan gorma a tha glè thearc, ach blasta, agus ma dh'itheas Gumbal tè dhiubh, tha a h-uile càil a' dol ceàrr! When the Blue Grub Moon appears, it brings out a very rare but delicious grub and if a Gumbal eats one, things go wrong!

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Troig is Bonns a’ feuchainn ri Gumbal-sgluidseadh, tha tubaist ann is tha iad suainte ri chèile. Feumar obrachadh còmhla ach ciamar a gheibh na caraidean air adhart leis a seo? When Troig and Bonns try to gumblesplat, they accidentally get entwined. They have to work together, but how will the friends get on with this?

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Leis an tuathanach agus Bitzer a' falbh a-mach airson latha còmhla ri chèile, tha Seonaidh a' gabhail a' chothruim a bhith os cionn ghnothaichean. Ach tha e a' mothachadh gu math luath nach eil an obair cho furasta 's a bha e an dùil. When the farmer decides it is time he and Bitzer head out for a bit of man and dog time, Shaun seizes his chance to take charge. He soon discovers that the job is not quite as easy as he first thought.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha Hilda a’ dol gu coinneamh nan Sgùdan Sporais ’son a’ chiad turas, is tha bràiste ri chosnadh. Tha i fhèin ’s a caraidean dol a sgioblachadh sa phàirc. Chan eil gnothaichean ag obrachadh mar a shaoileadh tu, ge-ta! Hilda goes to a Sparrow Scouts meeting for the first time, and there is a badge to be earned. She and her friends tidy up in the park, but things don’t work out as you would imagine!

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: Tha na seòid a’ cleachdadh mustard eadar-dhealaichte gus truinnsearan inntinneach a chruthachadh. Tha ùidh aig Ruairidh ann am mustard a tha ga dhèanamh sna Hearadh agus ag iarraidh air Ùisdean reòiteag a dhèanamh leis! Tha Ùisdean a’ toirt sùil air ais air reasabaidh traidiseanta airson slios feòla le mustard, air a ghabhail le buntàta Hasselback Ruairidh. Tha Ruairidh cuideachd ag ullachadh Cearc Supreme agus a’ cur crìoch air a’ phrògram le Carpaccio Bhiotais. The lads use different mustards to make a variety of dishes. Ruaridh is inspired by a Harris-made mustard and asks Uisdean to make ice cream, using the mustard! Uisdean looks back at a traditional recipe for Flank with mustard, accompanied by Ruaridh’s Hasselback potatoes. Ruairidh also prepares a classic, chicken supreme, and finishes off the episode with a beetroot carpaccio. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Joy Dunlop leads us on our Gaelic learning journey. Dr Teàrlach Wilson joins her in the studio, and Calum Maclean visits Govan while on the hunt for a collection of stones.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Cidsin Granaidh Chalanais
programme.desc: Gregor MacLeod takes on the classics shortbread and marmalade. Grannie has five recipes for shortbread alone, but Gregor has to pick just one.

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame/Rebuilding Notre-Dame
programme.desc: In 2019, a catastrophic fire threatened Notre-Dame’s structure. Analysing the vaults of the building, researchers unveil its history and decipher the secrets of its past resistance.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: Mar annlann a tha na thrèat air leth, tha Abigail a' dèanamh Briosgaidean Seasaman Tahini. Glè, glè bhlasta, a' brùchdadh le deagh bhlas is teòclaid geal! For a splendid accompaniment treat, Abigail makes tahini sesame cookies. Very tasty, packed with flavour and white chocolate! In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Sailm nan Daoine
programme.desc: Tha an ceòladair Rob MacNeacail air turas gus cumhachd seinn nan salm Gàidhlig a sgaoileadh. Musician Rob MacNeacail is on a mission to spread the power of Gaelic psalm singing.

programme.title: OMC!
programme.desc: A sketch show featuring a collection of comic characters, spoofs, inappropriate dates and a snapshot of the past. Written by and starring the very best in emerging and established comic talent. Featuring Iain Beggs, Darren Maclean, Carina Macleod, Claire Frances MacNeil, Hannah McKirdy, Lana Pheutan and David Walker. Includes sharpened words between mother and daughter in law, a new guy at work discovers what makes the office tick, and it’s eyes down for a coveted prize at the bingo. Anns an treas prògram bho shreath ùr OMC! chì sinn tuilleadh sgeidsichean loma-làn charactaran èibhinn, suidheachaidhean neònach agus ‘spoofs’ gun shamhail bho n sgrìobhadairean is cleasaichean as fheàrr a th’ann. An turas sa mòmaidean ain-fhoiseil le màthair cèile, duilgheadasan cainnt ann an obair ùr, agus duais air leth ri thogail aig am bingo! In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Meaban and Moo
programme.desc: Bidh Linda a’ tadhal air a caraidean Meaban is Moo sa bhothan aca gus dùbhlain spòrsail a chur romhpa. Seo tha i ag iarraidh orra trì diofar ghlasraich a lorg fhad ’s a tha iad cuideachd a' dèanamh deiseil airson partaidh Oidhche Shamhna. Tha treallaich gu leòr sa bhothan agus feumaidh Meaban is Moo a dhol a rùrach! Linda visits her friends Meaban and Moo at their hut to set them fun challenges. She tasks them with finding three different vegetables while they get ready for a Halloween party. Their hut is full of junk, so Meaban and Moo just need to have a good rummage!

programme.title: Leum Suas air an Sguaib/Room on the Broom
programme.desc: Tha Lìosaidh NicÌosaig, a' bhana-bhuidseach, 's an cat gu dòigheil a' seòladh air sguab. Tha a' ghaoth mhòr ag èirigh 's tha Lìosaidh a' call a h-ad, an rioban a tha na falt, 's an t-slatag a tha na làimh. Ge-ta, tha triùir charaidean eile a' nochdadh a bheir taic dhi. The witch and the cat fly through the sky on a broomstick. The wind picks up, the witch drops her hat, her bow and her wand. Fortunately, three more friends come to her aid. Can they rescue the witch from the dragon and will there be room on the broom for all?

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Mairi Mairi NicAongais a' leughadh Bana-phrionnsa a' Phoca Phàipeir. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Robert Munsch agus a dhealbhachadh le Michael Martchenko. Chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Jo NicDhòmhnaill. A bedtime story for young children. Mairi MacInnes reads Bana-phrionnsa a’ Phoca Phàipeir by Robert Munsch, illustrated by Michael Martchenko and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald.

programme.title: SpongeBob
programme.desc: Tha Mgr. Crùbag air a chlisgeadh mun sgrùdadh slàinte aige. Mr Krabs is too scared to get his physical.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Ged a tha na saor-làithean air tòiseachadh do sgoilearan Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche, tha latha a bharrachd aig an luchd-teagaisg airson beagan trèanaidh. Tha an t-eòlaiche-inntinn Sìleas Stern os cionn sheiseanan gus sìth agus càirdeas a stèidheachadh am measg an luchd-obrach. Although the holidays have started for the pupils of Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche, the teachers have an in-service day. Mr Mackle is keen to establish better relationships between his staff and has invited psychologist Sìleas Stern to run team building sessions that he hopes will bring peace and harmony.

programme.title: Calum: Cogadh nan Comhlan
programme.desc: Tha Calum airson a chòmhlann aige a thoirt à Glaschu dhan Òban airson blàr mòr ciùil a tha dol aig a' Mhòd Nàiseanta Rìoghail. Ach, le tòrr fharpaisean agus gainead tìde, chan eil cùisean a' dol mar bu chòir. Leis nach eil e furasda còmhlan a làimhseachadh aig na h-amannan as fheàrr, saoil ciamar a thèid dhaibh leis na dùbhlain mhòra a th' air thoiseach orra... Calum aims to take his band from Glasgow to Oban for a major musical battle at the Royal National Mòd. However, with numerous competitions and time constraints, things aren't going according to plan. Managing a band is never easy even in the best of times - how will they cope with the significant challenges that lie ahead?

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Nuair tha Camshron a' tighinn tarsainn air ugh iolair-dhubh, tha e airson an t-ugh a chumail dha fhèin. Tha e cho rag. Ciamar a gheibh na seòid air an ugh a thilleadh don nead 's a chumail sàbhailt’? When Cameron comes across a black eagle’s egg, he wants to keep the egg for himself - he is so stubborn! How will the gang manage to return the egg to the nest and keep it safe?

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha an tuathanach a' co-dhùnadh gu bheil an t-àm ann fàs fallain - agus tha e ag iarraidh Bitzer a thoirt a-steach air cùisean. Tha beachd eile aig Bitzer ge-tà agus tha e a' tighinn an àrd le plana dìomhair gus an obair chruaidh a sheachnadh. An dèan an sgeama aige a' chùis aig a' cheann thall? The farmer decides it is time to get fit and calls on Bitzer to join him. Bitzer has other ideas and comes up with a secret plan to avoid putting in the hard work. Will his scheme catch up with him in the end?

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: 'S e th' ann am Brot fìor bhlast' de Choiridh leantail, ach lòn sònraicht' nach dìochuimhnich thu ann an cabhaig. An extremely delicious curried lentil soup is a special lunch which you won't forget in a hurry. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Fonn mo Bheatha
programme.desc: Ceòl agus còmhradh le Cathy Ann Nic a Phi còmhla ri Jenna Cumming. Music and chat programme presented by Cathy Ann MacPhee with guest Jenna Cumming.

programme.title: Gàrraidhean Mòra na h-Alba
programme.desc: Murdo Macdonald explores Ardkinglas Gardens in Argyll. Murchadh Dòmhnallach a’cur eòlas air Gàrradh Àird Chonghlais ann an Earra-Ghaidheal.

programme.title: Cuirm aig Celtic
programme.desc: Ceòl is còmhradh bho cuirm shònraichte le Sian aig Celtic Connections. Anns a’ buidheann Ghàidhlig Albannach, tha triùir dhen na seinneadairean Gàidhlig as fheàrr – Eilidh NicCarmaig, Ceitlin Lilidh & Ellen NicDhòmhnaill – le luchd-ciùil eile nan cois gus an dàrna clàr aca a thaisbeanadh beò ann an dòigh nach cualas roimhe. Air a lìbhrigeadh le Megan NicGill-Fhaolain. Music and conversation from Sian’s concert at Celtic Connections to celebrate the release of their second album. The Scottish Gaelic folk group comprises three of today’s top Gaelic singers - Eilidh Cormack, Ceitlin Lilidh and Ellen MacDonald - who are joined by an extended line-up of musicians to perform the album live as never before. Presented by Megan MacLellan. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: An Geam Àlainn
programme.desc: Ball-coise nam ban ann an Alba bho shealladh luchd-cluiche, luchd-leantainn & eòlaichean. Women’s football in Scotland seen through the eyes of players, fans and experts.

programme.title: Ciad-fàthan nan Creutairean/Wild Senses
programme.desc: Ann an saoghal làn gleadhraich, ciamar a tha beathaichean a’ dèanamh ciall dheth? In a world filled with noise, how do animals make sense of it all?

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le December ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform December in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Skerryvore Aig Caisteal Floors
programme.desc: Prògram sònraichte a’ comharrachadh 20 bliadhna de Skerryvore. Chùm an còmhlan ainmeil Albannach cuirm shònraichte do nam mìltean de luchd-leantainn ann an àrainn àlainn Caisteal Floors sna Crìochan. Le agallamhan leis a’ chòmhlan is caraidean agus le criomagan bhon chonsairt. A special programme to celebrate 20 years of Skerryvore. The legendary Scottish band performed an anniversary show to thousands of fans in the spectacular surroundings of Floors Castle in the Scottish Borders. Featuring interviews with band members and friends, plus concert highlights. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Ann an turas sgoinneil eile, tha Hari a' dol air tòir 'map'. Tha e a' lorg scutair agus frith-rathad fhad's a tha e ga lorg, ach am bi aige air 'map' fhaighinn agus faighinn a-mach dè tha e a' dèanamh? In another 'aba-doo-be-dee' adventure, Hari goes in search of a map. He comes across a scooter and a pathway as he explores the area, but will he be able to find out what a map looks like and what it does?

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Teàrlach a’ faireachdainn tinn is chan eil e airson cluich. Tha Peicein agus a charaidean a’ feuchainn ri bruidhinn ris, tha iad a’ teagasg an cànan fhèin dha, is a’ feuchainn ri cainnt nan con ionnsachadh iad fhèin. Tadeo is feeling sick and doesn't want to play. Petit and his friends try to communicate with him, teaching Tadeo human language and trying to learn dog talk themselves.

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Pompon a’ faireachdainn nach eil sìon a' dol ceart dha, tha Dadaidh a' sealltainn dòigh dha air rudan a chur ceart! When Pompon feels that nothing is going right for him, Dadaidh shows him a way to sort things out!

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Tha Sionnach brònach nuair a chì e gun fheàrr le Maigheach a bhith a’ leughadh leabhar seach a bhith còmhla ris-san. Tha Tosg a’ moladh dhà e fhèin a chur ann an riochd ridire gaisgeil airson aire Maighich fhaighinn air ais. Tha an dithis aca a’ togail dràgon leis a’ bheachd gum faigh Sionnach buaidh air an dràgon, agus gun dearbh e a luach do Mhaigheach. When Hare would rather read her big book of fairytales than hang out with Fox, he fears he’s not exciting enough. According to Tusk, only by becoming a brave knight will Fox be able to prove the opposite is true. The two decide to build a dragon so Fox can beat it in battle and prove his worth to Hare.

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc: Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke are at home, stocking their cupboards with acorn flour, hedgehog mushrooms, juniper berries and angelica seeds for the winter.

programme.title: Faodail
programme.desc: Tha Tasglann Fhilm Faodail a’ tarraing aire gu filmichean dhùthchasach Innse Gall bho na 1930an gu na 80an, a bha caillte ach a-nis glèidhte don ghinealach ri teachd. Tha bhana Cinema Sgìre Leantainneach a’ siubhal nan eilean, a’ taisbeanadh fhilmichean sna sgìrean ionadail, le cothrom am faicinn air-loidhne air feadh an t-saoghail. Cuirear aithris bheairteach ùr riutha, a’ buntainn ris a’ Ghàidhealtachd, airson luchd-amhairc an là an-diugh. The Faodail Film Archive celebrates lost indigenous film collections from the 1930s-1980s in the Outer Hebrides, preserving the archive for future generations. The Cinema Sgìre Continuing mobile cinema van travels the islands showcasing footage to local communities, making them accessible globally online and adding rich new narratives relevant to the Gàidhealtachd for contemporary audiences. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Samhradh air Sàl
programme.desc: Angus Mackay is joined by close friend Finlay Macleod from Scalpay for the final fishing trip of the season. With summer fading, the environment looks very different as the purple heather really comes to the fore. Tracked by the golden eagle, they sail north to the hamlet of Calbost to take advantage of the shelter offered by its bay on a less than optimal day. As the duo fish in the bay, they ponder the extremes of the sea - its matchless beauty and its mortal danger. Anns a’ phrògram mu dheireadh san t-sreath, tha Fionnlagh MacLeòid à Sgalpaigh, còmhla ri Aonghas airson an turas iasgaich mu dheireadh den t-seusan. Leis an samhradh a’ tighinn gu crìoch, tha an àrainneachd a’ coimhead gu math eadar-dhealaichte, ‘s am fraoch purpaidh a’ tighinn am follais. Air an leantainn le iolaire-bhuidhe, seòlaidh iad gu tuath, gu Calbost gus beagan fasgadh fhaighinn sa bhàgh, air latha meadhanach grod. Fhad ’s a tha iad ag iasgach, tha iad a’ meòrachadh air an dà chuid cunnart agus bòidhchead na mara.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Highlights and previously unseen performances, featuring Mairi McGillivary, Ciaran Ryan and Fara. Roghainn fon sreath ciùil comhla ri Màiri Nicillebhrath, Ciaran Ryan and Fara.

programme.title: Fonn mo Bheatha
programme.desc: Music and chat programme presented by Cathy Ann MacPhee, with guest Calum Alex MacMillan. Ceòl agus còmhradh le Cathy Ann Nic a Phi còmhla ri Calum Ailig MacMhaolain. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Gàrraidhean Mòra na h-Alba
programme.desc: Murdo Macdonald explores Ardkinglas Gardens in Argyll. Murchadh Dòmhnallach a’cur eòlas air Gàrradh Àird Chonghlais ann an Earra-Ghaidheal.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: The vast landscape of the Cairngorms attracts thousands each year. Coinneach Rankin sets out on a multi-day expedition to learn why its vast mountains are a paradise for climbers, runners and so many others. Along with his partner, Coinneach races up one of the highest mountains in Scotland, undertakes a classic multi-pitch climb, and spends the night in a tiny bothy built in the 1960s. Tàlaidh cruth-tìre aibheiseach a’ Mhonaidh Ruaidh na mìltean gach bliadhna. Cuiridh Coinneach MacFhraing aghaidh air turas grunn làithean gus tuigsinn carson a tha sreapadairean, luchd-coise agus eile cho measail air na beanntan seo. An cuideachd deagh charaid, thèid Coinneach na dheann suas tè de na beanntan as àirde an Alba, dìreidh e slighe-sreapa fhada agus cuiridh e seachad na h-oidhche ann am bothan a thogadh ‘sna seasgadan. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay meets Ian Smith in the village he was brought up, before they head along one of Tiree’s most famous beaches. As they walk along the coast, Ian reflects on his youth and the people that impacted him. Ian discusses how the Tiree music scene shaped him and brought him success as a box player, and he shares his passion for the island and his pride in setting up the only distillery in Tiree. San treas sreath de Rathad Ramsay bidh Ramsay MacMahon a’ coinneachadh ri sàr Ghàidheil bho air feadh Alba ‘s iad a’ co-roinn sgeulachdan, cuir luach air nàdar agus a’ cnuasachadh ma beatha. Coinnichidh Ramsay ri Iain Mac a’ Ghobhainn sa bhaile san d’rugadh e mas dèan iad air tè de na tràighean as iomraitiche ann an Tiriodh. Meòirichidh Iain air làithean òige agus na daoine bu mhotha a thug buaidh air a bheatha. Leis cho cudromach ‘s a tha ceòl air eilean Thiriodh, innsidh Iain man bhuaidh a bh’aige seo air fhèin agus mar a chuidich e a bhith cho soirbheachail le cluich a’ bhogsa. Bidh an dà chuid a mheas air an eilean agus a mhoit man aon taigh-stàile san eilean fhaighinn stèidhichte follaiseach. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Ceol Sith
programme.desc: Come on a thrilling journey into the world of fairies and folklore with Ingrid Henderson. Thigibh air turas a-steach gu saoghal shìthichean agus creutairean os-nadarra eile le Ingrid NicEunraig.

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame/Rebuilding Notre-Dame
programme.desc: In 2019, a catastrophic fire threatened Notre-Dame’s structure. Analysing the vaults of the building, researchers unveil its history and decipher the secrets of its past resistance.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: 'S e th' ann am Brot fìor bhlast' de Choiridh leantail, ach lòn sònraicht' nach dìochuimhnich thu ann an cabhaig. An extremely delicious curried lentil soup is a special lunch which you won't forget in a hurry. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: An Geam Àlainn
programme.desc: Ball-coise nam ban ann an Alba bho shealladh luchd-cluiche, luchd-leantainn & eòlaichean. Women’s football in Scotland seen through the eyes of players, fans and experts.

programme.title: Na Trads
programme.desc: Na Trads: An Dara Teud. Roghainn bho oidhche mhòr duaisean Na Trads 2023, a tighinn à Talla Caird, Dùn Dè. Le Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Alistair Heather air an àrd-ùrlar agus air cùl stèids, coinneachaidh sin ris na luchd-ciùil agus na rionnagan a shoirbhich air an oidhche. Am measg na bhios a’ gabhail pàirt bidh Peatbog Faeries, Mànran, Joy Dunlop, Karine Polwart & Dave Milligan, Amy Laurenson, SC & T Youth agus an Robbie Shepherd Tribute. Highlights and music from the Trad Awards, from the Caird Hall, Dundee. Presenters Mary Ann Kennedy and Alistair Heather host the evening and we catch up with winners and stars of the event, both onstage and behind the scenes. Performances from Peatbog Faeries, Mànran, Joy Dunlop, Karine Polwart & Dave Milligan, Amy Laurenson, SC & T Youth and a musical tribute to a national treasure - the late Robbie Shepherd.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Le taic bho chàch, tha Pipp a’ dol na banrigh, le crùn, cathair agus parèid rìoghail. With a bit of Froggie help, Pipp turns into a queen with crown, throne and royal parade.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha Meanbh is Beag ag adhbharachadh tubaist a tha a’ gabhail a-steach dìtheanan bulgach, am Moo-adhair, agus a’ Chearc Iarainn. Ciamar a thèid cùisean a cheartachadh? Meanbh and Beag cause an accident which involves bubble flowers, the Sky-Moo and the Iron Chicken. How will they get things sorted?

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha Beag tro chèile oir cha d' fhuair e air na solais iongantach fhaicinn nuair a bha e a-muigh ’g iasgach san long-chiùil. Dè nì Am Màidsear airson togail a thoirt do Bheag? Beag is upset when he misses seeing two spectacular lights whilst out fishing in the music boat. What will Am Màidsear do to cheer Small up?

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Baba a' coinneachadh ri a charaid, Spiky, ach, chan eil Spiky airson cluich an-diugh - tha e troimh chèile 's e air a mhàthair a chall. Tha Baba cur roimhe Spiky a chuideachadh 's tha an dithis aca a' togail orra air turas-dàna! Baba is excited to meet his new friend Spiky, but Spiky doesn't want to play today as he has lost his mother and is very upset. Baba is determined to help and so the pair set off on an adventure to find her!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Oona 's Silky a' cur romhpa snàmh cuide ri na leumadairean ach tha Silky bochd a' tighinn an aghaidh creutair neònach a tha a' cur an dearg eagal orra! Tha an dithis a' dol gu Bernie gus faighinn a-mach dè seòrsa beathach a dh'fhaodadh a bhith ann. Oona and Sily's plan to spend the day swimming with dolphins is brought to a halt when a strange creature scares poor Silky witless. The pair visit Bernie to learn who, or what, this creature could possibly be.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Bing a’ cluich geama le fòn-làimhe Flop, chaneil rudan a’ dol mar bu chòir oir tha am fòn-làimhe a' briseadh nuair a tha e dol na sgeing air an làr. An àite seo innse do Flop, tha Bing ga chuir dhan bhiona. Tha e faireachdainn cho dona mun seo ach tha e ag ionnsachadh gum feum e innse mar a thachair. When Bing is playing a game with Flop’s mobile phone, he accidentally drops the mobile and it breaks. Instead of telling Flop, he throws it in the bin. He feels upset about it all and learns that it’s best to tell the truth.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Bing aig cuirm sa phàirc, tha còir aige 'n oidhch' a chrìochnachadh ach tha e air bhioran agus tha e fàs cho diùid. Ge-tà, le taic bho charaidean, tha e faighinn seachad air na duilgheadasan sin agus tha e a' seinn Òran a’ Bhogha-fhroise. When Bing is at a show in the park, he is extremely nervous as he is meant to be singing the finale. However, with help from his friends, Bing gets over all his insecurities and sings the Rainbow Song.

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Peicein is a charaidean gann de dh’airgead, is leis nach eil ann an airgead ach pìosan beaga pàipeir le dealbhan orra, tha iad uile a’ co-dhùnadh gun cruthaich iad an t-airgead aca fhèin, is gun ceannaich iad na thogras iad. Because they are a little short of money, and considering cash notes are only little papers with drawings on them, Petit and his friends decide to create their own money and buy anything they want.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha Hilda a’ dol gu coinneamh nan Sgùdan Sporais ’son a’ chiad turas, is tha bràiste ri chosnadh. Tha i fhèin ’s a caraidean dol a sgioblachadh sa phàirc. Chan eil gnothaichean ag obrachadh mar a shaoileadh tu, ge-ta! Hilda goes to a Sparrow Scouts meeting for the first time, and there is a badge to be earned. She and her friends tidy up in the park, but things don’t work out as you would imagine!

programme.title: A-null ’s a-nall
programme.desc: Nuair a tha aig Minho ri fuireach airson greiseag aig taigh Granaidh, chan eil a’ chùis ri còrdadh ris. Tha e taingeil, ge-tà, gu bheil Mango, a charaid, còmhla ris. When Minho has to stay at Granny’s for a while, he isn’t happy. He is, however, glad that his friend Mango is with him.

programme.title: Oidhche Shamhna CBBC ALBA
programme.desc: Tanith Rothach le taghadh a tha eagalach fhèin math airson Oidhche Shamhna, le slaidhm, braimeannan agus taibhse no dhà cuideachd! Tanith Munro introduces some frighteningly good highlights for Halloween, with slime, farts and a ghost or two!

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Tha Flix 'son dearbhadh g’ eil easan na shàr chat feireil – dìreach mar athair, Zeno. Chan eil a nàmhaid, Burma, dol a dhèanamh chùisean furasta dha, ge-tà! Flix wants to prove that he’s an ultimate outdoor cat - just like his dad, Zeno. However his nemesis Burma isn’t going to make things easy for him!

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Seachd Là
programme.desc: Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Salm 69 air a sheinn le Calum Ailig Mac a' Mhaolain, an laoidh Solas Na Grèine le Ceathrar-cheòil Còisir Ghàidhlig Ìleach Ghaschu agus bidh Mairead MacFhionghain ag innse mun phàirt a th' aig creideamh na beatha fhèin. Tha am prògram air aithris le Iain MacFhionghain. Psalm 69 sung by Calum Alex MacMillan, the hymn Solas na Grèine by Glasgow Islay Gaelic Choir Quartet and Margaret MacKinnon tells her own personal faith story. Presented by Iain MacKinnon.

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Tha Erica Nic a’ Phearsain air ais a’ toirt cruth-atharrachadh àlainn air seòmaran agus toglaichean le a dealbhachadh sònraichte. Leanaidh sinn i bho thoiseach gu deireadh phròiseactan is sinn a’ faicinn gach pàirt den phròiseas, bho phlana air pàipear gu bhith a’ trusadh stuthan airson crìoch snasail a chur orra. Interior designer Erica MacPherson is back to transform more rooms, homes and businesses. We follow her process from architectural plans to trawling auction houses and shops for finishing touches. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Sailm nan Daoine
programme.desc: Tha an ceòladair Rob MacNeacail air turas gus cumhachd seinn nan salm Gàidhlig a sgaoileadh. Musician Rob MacNeacail is on a mission to spread the power of Gaelic psalm singing.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le The Atholl Set ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform The Atholl Set in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Alba fon Talamh/Scotland Underground
programme.desc: In the Highlands and Islands, Calum explores the caves of Assynt, a Unesco global geopark, before travelling north to Orkney where there is a wealth of archeological underground sites. But it is also an example of the modern use of subterranean sites: oil to service the Scapa Flow naval sites was hidden underground in vast tanks beneath Wee Fea hill. The war theme continues as Calum visits a Cold War underground bunker in Inverness. Anns a’ Ghàidhealtachd agus na h-Eileanan, bheir Calum cuairt tro uamhan Asainte, geò-pàirc cruinneil UNESCO. À sin, thèid e tuath gu Arcaibh far a bheil beartas de làraich arceòlach fon talamh, ach cuideachd eisimpleir nas ùire den fho-thalamh a chleachdadh. Fo chnoc Wee Fea, tha na tancaichean mòra a bha a’ cumail ola ri làrach a’ Chabhlaich Rìoghail ann an Scapa Flow. A’ cumail ri tèama a’ chogaidh, ann an Inbhirnis tadhlaidh Calum air buncair bho àm a’ Chogaidh Fhuair. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc: Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke are at home, stocking their cupboards with acorn flour, hedgehog mushrooms, juniper berries and angelica seeds for the winter.

programme.title: Ceol Sith
programme.desc: Come on a thrilling journey into the world of fairies and folklore with Ingrid Henderson. Thigibh air turas a-steach gu saoghal shìthichean agus creutairean os-nadarra eile le Ingrid NicEunraig.

programme.title: Timewatch
programme.desc: Documentary that re-examines the attempt to blow up the Houses of Parliament in 1605 - one of the most famous yet least understood events in British history. It shows how the plot was almost England's 9/11, and asks why a group of young Englishmen became so radicalised and so hell-bent on terrorism. Computer graphics recreate what the Houses of Parliament looked like in 1605, and show just how close the plotters came to success.

programme.title: Secrets of Skin
programme.desc: Professor Ben Garrod reveals how skin protects vertebrates from extremes of temperature, the harmful effect of UV and a host of living organisms that want to get in.

programme.title: Gareth Edwards’s Great Welsh Adventure
programme.desc: Gareth and Maureen enlist in tank school and gear up for a drive like no other. In the Brecon Beacons, they discover if they’ve finally cracked the art of narrowboating.

programme.title: The Planets
programme.desc: Brian Cox continues his exploration of the solar system with a visit to a planet that dwarfs all the others: Jupiter. Its size gives it a great power that it has used to manipulate the other planets.

programme.title: Battlefield Britain
programme.desc: Dan Snow experiences how the Battle of Britain was fought at the limits of human endurance when he takes flight in a high performance stunt plane. Recreating the spiralling turns of a dogfight, he feels the extraordinary side-effects of the high G forces felt by pilots in this critical battle of World War II. Using revolutionary graphics, Peter Snow gives a blow-by-blow account of the pivotal moments of the battle and how the RAF held off the might of the German Luftwaffe during the summer of 1940. The future of the entire country was at stake in this, the first great air battle in history.

programme.title: The Guns of Navarone
programme.desc: Explosive World War II action yarn in which a group of crack commandos are assembled for an apparently impossible mission. The team, made up of Allied and Greek soldiers with specialist talents, attempt to destroy the seemingly impregnable German artillery units on the Greek island of Navarone and in turn free 2,000 British soldiers on Kiros, an island in the Aegean.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Classic horror. Fifteen years after murdering his sister, Michael Myers escapes from an asylum and returns to the small town of Haddenfield. Dr Sam Loomis, a psychiatrist who has been treating Michael, races to track him down before he kills again.

programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: On the night of Christmas 1998, a homeless man enters the infamous Greyfriars Kirkyard in Edinburgh. Seeking refuge, he breaks into the tomb of George Mackenzie - Edinburgh’s famous executioner - and then falls into an assembly of decomposing corpses. His screams are heard above ground, but something else has been disturbed. Within weeks, stories of blackouts and inexplicable attacks begin to spread. The injuries are so severe that Edinburgh City Council locks the gates and declares the area out of bounds for public safety. Jan Andrew Henderson begins to chronicle the Mackenzie Poltergeist - only to claim to become a target of its malice.

programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: In 1958, two young women travel together in a Ford Sedan to a nightclub in Georgia, on the other side of Lake Lanier. But they never return. Weeks later, reports begin of a ghostly figure: a lady wearing a blue dress, walking across the lake, whilst calls for help are heard from the waters below. Then, stories of unexplained drownings emerge. Mysterious deaths at Lake Lanier abound, whilst survivors report the feeling of being pulled into the depths or held beneath by unseen hands.

programme.title: Inside Classical
programme.desc: Join presenter and musician Owain Wyn Evans for a concert full of Halloween tricks and treats. The BBC National Orchestra of Wales, conducted by Ellie Slorach, perform music that is guaranteed to give you a thrill. The concert includes Bach’s gothic masterpiece Toccata and Fugue in D minor, Saint-Saëns Danse Macabre and the spine-tingling Rimsky Korsakov’s arrangement of Mussorgsky’s Night on the Bare Mountain. The orchestra take us to a world of magic and wonderment with film scores by John Williams, including Hedwig’s Theme from Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone, Flying Theme from ET, and the night wouldn’t be complete without one of the most forbidding and recognisable musical scores in cinematic history - The Shark Theme from Jaws!

programme.title: Battlefield Britain
programme.desc: Dan Snow experiences how the Battle of Britain was fought at the limits of human endurance when he takes flight in a high performance stunt plane. Recreating the spiralling turns of a dogfight, he feels the extraordinary side-effects of the high G forces felt by pilots in this critical battle of World War II. Using revolutionary graphics, Peter Snow gives a blow-by-blow account of the pivotal moments of the battle and how the RAF held off the might of the German Luftwaffe during the summer of 1940. The future of the entire country was at stake in this, the first great air battle in history.

programme.title: Disco at the BBC
programme.desc: Another fantastic selection of dance floor disco classics, featuring a wealth of performances from the BBC’s music archives, including Tina Charles, The Real Thing, Sister Sledge and The Bee Gees.

programme.title: Studio 54
programme.desc: In 1970s New York, one nightclub defined an era and a generation. For the first time, Ian Schrager, one of the two people behind the infamous Studio 54, tells the in-depth story of how one of the world’s greatest nightclubs was created. Studio 54 was the epicentre of 70s hedonism - a place that not only redefined the nightclub, but also came to symbolise an entire era. Its co-owners, Ian Schrager and Steve Rubell, two friends from Brooklyn, seemed to come out of nowhere to suddenly preside over a new kind of New York society. Now, 46 years after the velvet rope was first slung across the club’s hallowed threshold, a feature documentary tells the real story behind one of the greatest clubs of all time.

programme.title: Disco: Soundtrack of a Revolution
programme.desc: At the end of the 1970s, the founding principles of disco – queerness, diversity and feminism – were coming under increasing attack from a predominantly white, straight, rock-loving audience. By the summer of 1978, disco appeared untouchable, but mass marketing and rampant commercialism were beginning to turn the tide. A glut of bad disco singles and the perceived elitism of clubs like Studio 54 fuelled a surge in anti-disco feeling. This is the story of how disco died - and where it went.

programme.title: Sounds of the Seventies
programme.desc: Disco was all pervasive in the mid and early 70s. And while towards the end of the decade punk stole the headlines, disco still had the high street. Everyone was into it and getting down on it at the local discotheque. Join us in a celebration of all things disco including performances by The Jacksons, Thelma Houston, Sylvester, Carl Douglas, George McCrae, Sister Sledge, McFadden and Whitehead, Eruption and Gloria Gaynor.

programme.title: Fungi: The Web of Life
programme.desc: Much of life on earth is connected by a vast, hidden network that we are only just beginning to understand. Out of sight, between the world of plants and animals, another realm exists - the kingdom of fungi. Passionate biologist and writer Merlin Sheldrake travels the globe, exploring the secret world of fungi. Through dazzling images of fungi under the microscope and all around us in the forest, Merlin unravels the many secrets of these essential organisms. So much more than mushrooms, not only do fungi shape the weather and support life on land, they are also at the cutting edge of medical research and even have the power to break down plastic waste. This film takes us from the ancient Tasmanian Tarkine rainforest to the mystical wilds of China’s Yunnan Province, in search of solutions to some of our planet’s biggest challenges. Can the answers be found in the wonderful world of fungi?

programme.title: Full Circle with Michael Palin
programme.desc: Michael Palin undertakes a journey around the Pacific Rim through 18 countries. Arriving in Qingdao, Michael checks into his hotel - which is curiously like a Bavarian castle - and finds himself in a room that was once Chairman Mao's. Having climbed China's holiest mountain, he travels to Shanghai to see the new face of the nation, then takes a steamboat trip on the Yangtze River

programme.title: Miss Marple
programme.desc: While the investigation centres on the Jefferson family and their entourage, Miss Marple's hunch about a second killing proves all too tragically justified.

programme.title: Fanny and Alexander
programme.desc: Ingmar Bergman’s dreamlike chronicle of an extended family in early 20th-century Sweden. One tumultuous year in the life of the Ekdahl family is viewed through the eyes of ten-year-old Alexander, whose imagination fuels the magical goings-on leading up to and following the death of his father. When his mother marries a stern bishop, Alexander and his sister Fanny are banished to a gothic world.

programme.title: Arena
programme.desc: Film-maker Ingmar Bergman shows us his world on the desolate and mysterious Baltic island of Faro. In his home at the seashore, he talks about the childhood that shaped him and speaks of how the art of film was often a comfort to him. He tells, too, of love and death, and lists his worst demons.

programme.title: To the Manor Born
programme.desc: Stately sitcom. Audrey upbraids Richard for not sponsoring a charity event in aid of a new scout hut.

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Hyacinth has decided that, instead of her usual gift to Richard of slippers, he should receive skis instead. When Richard protests that he has no intention of taking up the sport, Hyacinth responds that he can cultivate the correct image by strapping them atop the car and drive about with them occasionally.

programme.title: Fungi: The Web of Life
programme.desc: Much of life on earth is connected by a vast, hidden network that we are only just beginning to understand. Out of sight, between the world of plants and animals, another realm exists - the kingdom of fungi. Passionate biologist and writer Merlin Sheldrake travels the globe, exploring the secret world of fungi. Through dazzling images of fungi under the microscope and all around us in the forest, Merlin unravels the many secrets of these essential organisms. So much more than mushrooms, not only do fungi shape the weather and support life on land, they are also at the cutting edge of medical research and even have the power to break down plastic waste. This film takes us from the ancient Tasmanian Tarkine rainforest to the mystical wilds of China’s Yunnan Province, in search of solutions to some of our planet’s biggest challenges. Can the answers be found in the wonderful world of fungi?

programme.desc: On one of the wettest days in Roadshow history, over 2,000 visitors queue to see Fiona Bruce and the experts sheltering under the canopy at Minehead station, which is run by West Somerset Railway. Objects brought to camera include a bracelet made from jewels once owned by the last of the Romanovs, the Russian royal family, photographs from the day The Beatles came to film A Hard Day's Night and a bronze by sculptor Rodin.

programme.title: A Stitch in Time
programme.desc: Fusing biography, art and the history of fashion, Amber Butchart explores the lives of historical figures through their clothes. She looks at Marie Antoinette.

programme.title: Pubs, Ponds and Power: The Story of the Village
programme.desc: Archaeologist Ben Robinson unlocks the ancient roots of the Northumberland village of Warkworth. With the help of locals, he discovers clues that point back almost 1,000 years to the Norman conquest when the invaders laid the foundations of a planned community, still visible to this day.

programme.title: Shakespeare: Rise of a Genius
programme.desc: Shakespeare’s life and legacy is threatened when the Gunpowder Plot unearths a secret he has worked all his life to bury: his family are Catholics, traitors to the crown. When his daughter is implicated in the fallout, Shakespeare unleashes his most epic work to date: Macbeth, which appeals to the new monarch, King James I. As Shakespeare teeters towards death, he reflects on his successes and failures, questioning family, forgiveness and mortality as his work is at risk of being lost forever.

programme.title: The Interface
programme.desc: The show that reaches through your screen, to tell you the tech stories that ready matter. Hosted by BBC technology journalist Thomas Germain and social media expert Professor Jessica Maddox, The Interface dives into the stories, trends, apps, gadgets, algorithms and internet obsessions shaping how we live, work, think and connect. From AI and influencers to memes, data leaks, cybersecurity and the weirdest corners of the web, The Interface explores what happens when technology collides with real life. Cutting through the hype, the hosts unpack the platforms, products and online phenomena that increasingly shape our choices, our culture and our sense of self - whether we like it or not! Sharp, insightful and often very funny, The Interface examines our relationship with technology in all its messy, brilliant, absurd and world-changing glory. Along the way, it tackles one of the biggest questions of our age: what kind of future are the likes of Elon Musk, Chat GPT and all the other Silicon Valley giants building, and does anyone really want to live there?

programme.title: Clive Myrie's African Adventure
programme.desc: In the second leg of his Ghanaian adventure, Clive heads 80 miles from the capital city of Accra to the picturesque fishing ports of Cape Coast and Elmina, where he digs deep into his ancestral roots. He takes part in one of Ghana's most exciting tribal celebrations as he’s welcomed by the Fante people. He's given a new name by elders from the group, as well as a personalised Fante flag that celebrates both his West African and Jamaican roots. As part of this journey, Clive makes a difficult but moving visit to a former slave fort to discover some of what his ancestors went through. And, in a personal first, Clive gets to dance in a hip-hop video with rising star Kojo Vypa.

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: A weekly programme from the BBC World Service, bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories. In this episode: Nawal Al-Maghafi reports from Yemen's front lines, where Houthi forces are posing the most serious threat in years to the city of Taiz, raising fears of a major escalation in a conflict that has endured for more than a decade. We also trace the roots of Yemen's war, exploring how the country's strategic location has drawn it into a struggle involving Saudi Arabia, Iran and the United States. Plus: BBC Mundo travels to Panama's Coiba Island, a biodiversity hotspot, to explore how a former prison colony helped preserve a rare and fragile natural world.

programme.title: Talking Movies
programme.desc: Talking Movies looks at the films that made waves at the BFI London Film Festival and the New York Film Festival in October. Tom Brook explores the film Elsinore, which contains a magnetic performance from Andrew Scott portraying the actor Ian Charleson, and is already being tipped for Oscar glory. Martin McDonagh's Wild Horse Nine also made a big impression and we talk to the director as well as the cast from the festival red carpet. Wedaeli Chibelushi offers her thoughts on the new African drama Congo Boy and Emma Jones looks at Spanish film La Bola Negra, which has been earning rave reviews and is being talked about as a serious contender for the Best Film category at Academy Awards in 2027. Plus, we head to the USA for a look at the New York Film Festival which opened with the crime drama Paper Tiger. Other standout films there included the documentary Once Upon A Time in Harlem and Mike Leigh's Tender Loving Care.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: This week the BBC announced more cuts as part of its drive to save £500 million, following on from a series of other budget saving measures over the last few months. Katie and Ros take stock of everything announced so far along with a panel of experts: ex-BBC executive Roger Mosey, MP for Southport Patrick Hurley, Baroness Morgan, former Secretary of State for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport and the BBC Deputy Director General Rhodri Talfan-Davies. And a new Channel 4 programme investigates public attitudes toward disability. The creators of The Experiment have built a fictional care home for disabled people and invite members of the public into the facility to see if they can recognise Nazi-era concepts disguised as modern social care. Producer Nick Parnes and presenter Sophie Morgan join the show.

programme.desc: Why are record amounts of money pouring into sport? The LA Lakers are starting the new NBA as the most expensive sports team in history after being bought for $12.5bn. Is it really being driven by the search for an AI proof investment? programme.desc: In the second leg of his Ghanaian adventure, Clive heads 80 miles from the capital city of Accra to the picturesque fishing ports of Cape Coast and Elmina, where he digs deep into his ancestral roots. He takes part in one of Ghana's most exciting tribal celebrations as he’s welcomed by the Fante people. He's given a new name by elders from the group, as well as a personalised Fante flag that celebrates both his West African and Jamaican roots. As part of this journey, Clive makes a difficult but moving visit to a former slave fort to discover some of what his ancestors went through. And, in a personal first, Clive gets to dance in a hip-hop video with rising star Kojo Vypa.

Record sums have also been spent on the NFL's Seattle Seahawks and English Premier League teams Liverpool and Chelsea in recent weeks. Is it really being driven by the search for an AI proof investment? Sal Galatioto is the man billionaires call when they want to buy or sell a sports team and he explains why the prices keep on climbing. Leading TV sports rights executive Daniel Cohen, of Octagon Global Media Consulting, explains the impact this is all having on how we watch and how much we pay. programme.title: Africa: From Reparations to Action
programme.desc: African Heads of State have gathered at the annual Elevate Africa Presidential Roundtable in Accra, Ghana, to examine how the push for reparations for the transatlantic slave trade can move from recognition and resolutions to meaningful action. In a special Focus on Africa roundtable discussion hosted by Waihiga Mwaura, leaders explore the role of African governments, the African Union, Caribbean partners, and the wider international community in advancing reparative justice. The conversation also looks ahead, asking how Africa can engage its young people in shaping the reparations agenda, strengthen ties with the diaspora, encourage investment and return migration, and create opportunities that support the continent's future development. Bringing together questions of historical accountability and future prosperity, the discussion challenges leaders to move beyond declarations and chart a practical path towards reparative justice and sustainable development.

programme.title: The Football Interview
programme.desc: The Football Interview sees the biggest names in sport and entertainment join host Kelly Somers for bold, in-depth conversations about the nation’s favourite sport. We explore mindset and motivation, reflect on defining moments and career highs, and discuss personal insights. It’s a chance to show an honest, human and sometimes surprising side to familiar faces. At the heart of this is Kelly Somers – one of the most trusted, versatile and authentic voices in sports broadcasting. Kelly brings a brand of warmth and relatability that resonates with both athletes and audiences. What sets her apart is her ability to dig deeper with a sensitive approach, creating a space where athletes feel comfortable being open, honest and at times vulnerable. Each episode sees Kelly draw out stories and insight from the player behind the name about the beautiful game, their origins and values, and a look-ahead to the future from a sporting and personal perspective. She takes her subjects on a journey – and takes the viewer with her.

programme.title: Grand Tours of Scotland's Rivers
programme.desc: The River North Esk, which lies south of Edinburgh, is a hidden gem. Paul follows it from the Pentland Hills through a landscape steeped in myth and legend. From the picturesque and delightful Habbie’s Howe, he reaches Roslin Glen, which inspired some of our greatest artists and writers - especially the mysterious Rosslyn Chapel on the cliffs above. The power of the river was later harnessed for papermaking. Paul discovers the legacy of industry before heading to ancient Musselburgh on the coast near Edinburgh.

programme.title: Jules and Greg's Wild Swim

Arlene sails to Jura to see how the locals cope with the huge deer population and find new outlets for venison. Anne discovers how the shortage of affordable rural housing is being tackled in the Highlands. And Shahbaz is on the shores of Loch Linnhe near Fort William to see the stranded fishing boat that has become a local landmark.

Acting Sergeant Ken Beattie can’t please everyone or anyone with his socially distanced community quiz, while an eco-aware Chief Miekelson ensures his force have a bigger carbon footprint than the bams.

programme.title: The Chief
programme.desc: The Chief signs up for a personal revamp after his colleagues point out a long list of his privileges. He eagerly enrols in a programme of modules and workshops specifically suited to today’s ever-evolving workplace. No-one is keener to surf society’s wave of woke than ally-to-all Cameron Miekelson. Across the organisation, the Chief becomes a visible, enthusiastic agent of change in the hope that he can delay any changes. As he feels the tide of history rising higher, he has to work ever harder to keep his head above water.

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Will and Dan tackle a scale model of the world’s only rotating boat lift: the Falkirk Wheel. There are missing cogs and broken bearings, while an underperforming motor demand precision repairs. In the barn, Dom entrusts Wappy - a soft toy that saw Robbie through life-saving treatment in Dundee - to Julie and Amanda for a sensitive rebuild, before Will swaps timber for silver as he makes a decorative bowl with celebrated silversmith Katie Watson.

programme.title: Our Lives
programme.desc: This Our Lives documentary tells the story of Boots and Beards, a Scots Asian-run hillwalking group helping people from ethnic minority backgrounds explore the great outdoors. We join the group as it gathers once again after a year in lockdown and prepares to celebrate its landmark 100th walk. We meet the group’s founders, Naveed Baksh and Kashif Butt, whose close friendship has been a driving force behind the success of the group. Their fortnightly hillwalks began as a way to spend more time with close friends and family, but have grown into a community event that has transformed lives. Naveed also travels to Fort William, the small Highland town where his parents first settled when coming to the UK. There, he’s joined by Kashif for a walk up Ben Nevis, the highest mountain in the country and the pair’s greatest hillwalking challenge to date.

programme.title: Mythland
programme.desc: Witches dominate popular culture, but behind the fantasy lies a brutal history of female persecution. Evelyn and Zara investigate the mysterious case of Lilias Adie, a local woman accused of witchcraft in Torryburn, Fife, in 1704 - with shocking results.

programme.title: Mythland
programme.desc: UFOs, alien encounters, government cover-ups and mysterious lights in the sky - the myths surrounding extraterrestrial life have fascinated us for decades. But where does the truth end and the legend begin? Zara and Evelyn head to Scotland’s infamous Falkirk Triangle, a UFO hotspot at the centre of extraordinary claims, to investigate why these stories take hold and whether there is any truth behind them. Meeting passionate UFO spotters, a sceptical academic and a former RAF press officer, they explore how science fiction, media hype and conspiracy theories have helped fuel our fascination with the unexplained. From claims of secret government files to the remarkable case of forestry worker Robert Taylor, whose alleged encounter in 1979 remains shrouded in mystery, Zara and Evelyn uncover the stories behind Scotland’s enduring UFO mythology. With eyewitness accounts, archive footage and intriguing forensic evidence, can Zara and Evelyn separate fact from folklore? Are these sightings misunderstood phenomena, myths that have taken on a life of their own, or evidence that we’re not alone?

programme.title: Body on the Beach: What Happened to Annie?

programme.desc: Philomena Cunk visits the allegedly beautiful city of Florence to explore the Renaissance and interrogates experts and historians about the revolutions that went on to shape the modern world, including the American War of Independence and, to a lesser extent, the French Revolution.

programme.title: Cunk on...
programme.desc: Cunk continues her ambitious march across the face of mankind into an age of industry and science. With the help of historians, she explains the scientific breakthroughs of Marie Curie and Albert Einstein. She demonstrates the inventions that changed the world and covers how the American Civil War, World War I and World War II taught humanity how to use its new grasp of technology to shoot, blow up and irradiate itself in huge numbers.

programme.title: Cunk on...
programme.desc: In the final episode of her epic journey across history, Philomena Cunk takes us from 1945 to the present day. She travels the world and meets top experts to examine the Cold War, the space race, globalisation and social media. The world's recent history is one of polarisation and division as humanity divided itself down the middle – communism v capitalism, Apple v Microsoft, Beatles v Stones. Is humanity doomed to repeat the mistakes of history? Cunk does her best to find out.

programme.desc: Mervin and the team investigate the murder of a local newspaper’s notorious agony aunt, poisoned the morning after her retirement party while reading her final advice column. The paperboy is swiftly ruled out, but the police are left stumped when he insists he delivered the stack of papers at random. Nobody else in the neighbourhood was taken ill, so how could the killer have ensured the victim would pick up the only poisoned copy? Meanwhile, Mervin resists the counselling sessions Selwyn has imposed after the case in Antigua. And as he grapples with his feelings towards his brother, Mervin gets a rude awakening from an unexpected figure. Is blood really thicker than water?

programme.desc: It’s Halloween in Finglas, and everyone is getting into the spooky spirit of things. Agnes is ready for the trick or treaters, but she gets more than she bargained for when she receives a surprising visitor from her past. As no-one else can see her ghostly guest, they think she’s gone mad - not even Doctor Flynn can help. Luckily, Father Damien is on hand, and with a little help from Grandad, they get rid of the unwanted guest in time to head down to Foley’s for a fancy-dress party.

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: The new year starts badly when Winnie’s place is burgled and her mother’s much-loved wedding ring is missing. Meanwhile, Cathy is worried about her impending birthday.

The Traitors meet for the first time.

The line-up features contestants from across the country, ranging in age from 24 to 61 and including teachers, a postal worker, a psychotherapist, a musician, a stay-at-home dad, an Irish Defence Forces member, and an actor and drama teacher. Hosted once again by Siobhán McSweeney, the players attempt to navigate a game built on trust, strategy and deception, forming alliances while trying to work out who among them they can believe.

programme.desc: When twin brothers find their father's old monkey toy, a series of gruesome deaths begins. Desperate to stop the carnage, the siblings decide to throw the toy away but are forced to confront their past years later. Based on a Stephen King short story.

programme.title: OnlyFans: Inside the Machine
programme.desc: Behind the billion-pound success of OnlyFans lies a hidden ecosystem of exploitation. A BBC Current Affairs investigation uncovers allegations of exploitation, coercion and violence committed by some of the hundreds of agents who manage many of the platform’s creators as well as the potential for modern slavery. Through survivor testimony, undercover access to a managers’ chat forum and expert legal analysis, the film exposes an industry where young women are trapped, threatened and profited from - raising urgent questions about accountability at the heart of one of Britain's most lucrative tech companies.

programme.title: This Country
programme.desc: It is the most important day of the year for Kerry - the annual steam fair. And as a bonus, this year it falls on her birthday, and Kurtan has organised her a surprise present. However, the present involves some walking, and so the cousins embark on a cross-country trek. This affords them the time to share some local village myths with the crew, such as the legend of the Fox Twins.

programme.title: This Country
programme.desc: Family loyalty is vital in rural communities, and Kerry's lifelong ambition has been to work with her father, Martin. She is therefore overjoyed when he asks her to help him store some wares in a lock-up garage. A job at the local bowls club gives Kurtan a new sense of purpose, but when Kerry entangles Kurtan in her new venture, things start to unravel, and the Mucklowe family loyalties are put to the test.

programme.title: My Mate's a Bad Date
programme.desc: Georgie’s best mate Vicky is the ultimate dating ice queen. Vicky is super-picky, has a long list of unrealistic criteria for her perfect match, dumps guys for using the wrong emojis, analyses everything they do and walks out of 60 per cent of her dates. Tired of hearing about Vicky’s first date failures and delivering advice that gets ignored, Georgie calls on sex and relationships expert Oloni for an urgent intervention. Oloni wants Vicky to see where it's all going wrong, so she dishes out some cold, hard truths as she unpacks Vicky’s dating history and shows her some frank and honest video feedback from friends, family and even exes, to prove to Vicky that her bad dating behaviour needs a serious reboot. Oloni has to pull out all the stops to melt this ice queen as she sets Vicky up on a series of first dates that will challenge her behaviour and make her a better dater. Under the watchful eye of Oloni and Georgie, is Vicky ready for a change, will she give the guys a chance, be nice and let her guard down, or will she retain her ice queen crown?

programme.desc: See Hear celebrates the beautiful game, exploring deaf football, the fight for accessibility and the inspiring people breaking down barriers on and off the pitch. In the studio, presenter Ahmed Mudawi welcomes Oliver Eadsforth, a passionate advocate for deaf football who works with the England and Great Britain teams, supporting players and helping develop the game on and off the pitch. Oliver reflects on his lifelong love of football, from playing goalkeeper at school and university to taking on roles in administration, player development and international football. He discusses the progress made in deaf sport, the importance of having a voice in decision-making and why more opportunities are needed for deaf people to become coaches and leaders.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo’s exploration of Essex reaches Chelmsford. At a huge construction site on the outskirts of the city he discovers Beaulieu Park, the first railway station to be built on the Great Eastern Main Line for over 100 years. Michael learns how the station is designed to alleviate congestion in Chelmsford city centre. At Chelmsford Cathedral, the headquarters of the diocese of Chelmsford, Michael meets the bishop of Chelmsford, the Rt Revd Dr Guli Francis-Dehqani. He discovers one of the largest and most diverse dioceses in England and hears Bishop Guli’s extraordinary personal story of escape from Iran after the Islamic revolution of 1979. Michael continues his rail journey on the Great Eastern Main Line and visits the historic riverside town of Maldon, with its pretty Thames barges. Michael learns about a medieval battle and handles a rare Viking sword. He finishes this leg of his Essex journey in the coastal village of Tollesbury, with its strong maritime heritage and marshy landscape, a haven for birds and wildlife.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Arriving in the Essex market town of Witham, Michael heads into the countryside to visit Terling Place, one of the county’s great country houses. He hears how in the late 19th century, Victorian scientist the 3rd Baron Rayleigh discovered the atmospheric gas argon here. Michael joins the Braintree branch line - aka the Flitch line - and alights at Cressing to visit two huge medieval barns that are thought to be the oldest timber-framed structures in England. At Braintree, Michael learns about the town's wool and silk industries before heading to the Warner and Sons archive, where he discovers a depository of thousands of silk patterns, including two pieces with a royal connection. At Great Bardfield, Michael traces a group of artists including Edward Bawden and Eric Ravilious, who settled in the pretty Essex village from the 1930s onwards. He meets the author of a book on the artists, who now lives in their former home.

programme.desc: Relive some of the biggest hits of 1996 with these Top of the Pops classic performances. Summer hits were aplenty with Peter Andre, Gina G and Los Del Rio all bringing sunshine to Elstree. Hooks in hip-hop proved dominant with Dr Dre, Blackstreet, Mark Morrison, Toni Braxton and the Fugees all scoring huge hits. Britpop was still booming, with Oasis continuing to dominate singles sales with Sleeper hot on their heels. Global dance classics were born courtesy of Faithless and Robert Miles, and add into the mix the awesome arrival of Spice Girls, plus many more, and it’s not a year to miss. Artists featured include Spice Girls, Suede, The Fugees, Babylon Zoo, Beautiful South, Mark Morrison, Sleeper, Los Del Rio, Peter Andre, Alanis Morrisette, Manics, Dr Dre, Blackstreet, Robret Miles, Space, OMC, Garbage, Gina G, Kula Shaker, Toni Braxton, Babybird and Oasis.

The Calshot crew face a tense search in thick fog for a motorboat with engine failure - somewhere in the busy shipping lanes of the Solent. The ramble is returning for its 12th year, set against the stunning backdrop of the Peak District. The presenters walk alongside five remarkable young people who have faced significant challenges, hearing first-hand how BBC Children in Need-funded projects have helped them build confidence, resilience and hope for the future.

Arlene sails to Jura to see how the locals cope with the huge deer population and find new outlets for venison. Anne discovers how the shortage of affordable rural housing is being tackled in the Highlands. And Shahbaz is on the shores of Loch Linnhe near Fort William to see the stranded fishing boat that has become a local landmark.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek is island-hopping in this round-up of his favourite Welsh island walks. He goes wild in west Wales as he sails to Skomer Island – a national nature reserve of international importance due to its seabirds - where he gets a close-up view of the puffins, razorbills and guillemots before staying up late to see the Manx shearwater. Next, Derek goes to Flat Holm Island, where he braves a huge colony of seagulls and discovers more about the island's past, including some Victorian gun placements. Lastly, Derek heads up north to Wales's largest island, Anglesey, where he visits another tiny island with a secluded chapel, an unexpected motor racing track, a neolithic burial chamber and a sauna on a beach.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt dishes up a feast of food from the Saturday Kitchen archives to whet the appetite for the week ahead. The Hairy Bikers bring comfort food bang up to date with sticky Szechuan lamb, stuffed into pillowy soft bao buns, with a fresh hit of pickled carrots, spring onion and herbs – cosy comfort with a fragrant Asian twist! Meera Sodha introduces a taste of Sri Lanka to the studio as she continues the comfort theme with her warming lentil and coconut dal with crispy mustard kale. Jeremy Lee brings his effervescent charm and wit to the kitchen whilst giving an underused cut of meat its chance in the spotlight. He makes a rich steamed kid pudding that melts in the mouth. Mary McCartney celebrates Bonfire Night with her flavour-packed smoky dogs, while Carmen O’Neal and Idris Elba team up to serve a masterclass in brandy. And queen of puddings Nigella Lawson tucks into either her food heaven, scallops, or her food hell, candied fruit. Meanwhile, Rick Stein explores the New Forest's bounty of produce, and the Hairy Bikers make a Menorcan dish in the Mediterranean Sea.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France

In Strasbourg, Eva stops off at Brasserie Le Tigre for a beer (brassier means ‘to brew’) and a deliciously creamy tarte flambee. Then there's a trip to guide Coralie Andt’s restaurant, known as a winstub, where French wines can be enjoyed with plenty of cheese and sausage – as well as more sausage with sauerkraut cooked in white Riesling wine. With French tarts in a brasserie that serves German-style beer, and German sausage in a winstub serving French white wine, Alsace is defined by its competing national influences.

programme.title: Best Bakes Ever

Each episode gives baking fans another chance to experience classic dishes from the likes of the James Martin, Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood, the Hairy Bikers, Raymond Blanc, Nigella Lawson, Tom Kerridge, Lorraine Pascale and Rachel Khoo. There's added insight and appreciation from Jane herself too. Whether its cakes, pies, puddings or main courses - this greatest hits of baking is a must for anyone with a need to knead, and should help inspire even more of us to start getting creative in the kitchen.

programme.title: Horrible Histories
programme.desc: Did you know that the Victorians invented films? Not only that, but one of the first stars of the moving image was Queen Victoria! Using real footage recently restored by the BFI, this special show takes a Horribly Historical look at the Victorians’ obsession with film. We see some of Queen Vicky’s very first filmic appearances (also featuring an initially reluctant Tsar Nicholas I), and also how the Victorians became obsessed with filming everything, from their holidays abroad to strapping cameramen to the front of a moving train (using only ropes) to make ‘Phantom Ride’ films. Along the way we also meet the Lumiere brothers (one of whom looks a lot like First Dates' Fred Sirieix), Kaiser Wilhelm II, notable Victorian actor Herbert Beerbohm Tree, and we see that the Victorians were also early adopters of Fake News. The episode ends with a show-stopping song that traces the evolution of film from the Victorians’ first forays through to the blockbusters we see in the multiplexes today.

The Twirlywoos decide to line them up, taking turns to place one colour next to the other. They make a long line of blocks which stretches across the boat, finishing outside Peekaboo's hole. While the Twirlywoos are busy celebrating, Peekaboo peeps out and knocks the end block, causing it to fall into the one next to it, until they all collapse, domino-style! This is repeated several times, with the Twirlywoos setting up the blocks and Peekaboo knocking them down again. In the end, the Twirlywoos chase after their rings, and Peekaboo takes the blocks into the hole.
