programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Nori and Dot are stuck in a treehouse without a door. How can Mojo and Bo get them out? By sending the treehouse flying across town, that’s how!

programme.title: Activate with Joe Wicks
programme.desc: Roll up, roll up! It's my Big Top Challenge! We'll be learning new circus skills in this one. The main entertainment will be spectacular arm circles, extravagant twisters and wonderful peekaboos. The finale is the Activate! Come on in and get ready to move with Joe and the Activators.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: There's make-believe fun for Justin and his friend as they pretend to run a pizza restaurant. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble is knitting a fancy new jumper to wear for his pretend fashion show.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: A game of 'grannies' is fun, until Bluey and Bingo can't agree on one simple question: Can Grannies dance? Now they need to video call Nana to get the answer.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: On the beach, Bingo and Dad get creative when they find a stick shaped like a bird’s head.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels had a great adventure outside and want to tell everyone about it. What better way to tell a story than through a puppet show? First they make the puppets, using scissors, card, glue, glitter and feathers. Then it's time for an amazing show for all their friends! But wait a minute... who is this unexpected guest in the big black car?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee uses his trusty binoculars to do some birdwatching, and of course the Squirrels want to have a go too. The problem is, if you want to go birdwatching you have to be very, very quiet, otherwise the birds will fly away. And being very, very quiet is difficult when you have Roly with you. Bird! Bird! Bird! Can Roly remember to whisper? And is Duggee's sneeze just a little too loud?

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Madam Dragon comes to the clinic with a bad case of wingpetigo. Zog miraculously cures her but is baffled by how he did it.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Nugget’s new fitness device sparks a craze on the berg. Running, skating and jumping, the Piris battle it out to score the most points, with a surprise winner.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi wishes for a puppy to prove she’s ready for another family pet, but magical pup Beanbag’s mischievous antics soon teach her that caring for a pet is a big responsibility.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The eagle family are performing synchronised flight. The ducklings are blown away and join the eagle family, who teach them how to fly in formation. Weasy feels left out and finds a way to fly 'for real' so that he can also take part.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: Rhino steals a mother goose. Lockjaw stops Black Cat.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: A storm in Vietnam floods a cave, trapping Ryla, Kwazii, Shellington - and a tiger!

programme.title: Knee High Spies
programme.desc: Lauchie and Scarlett make a homemade movie, but Silver Paw wants to be the superstar.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the Pea-Rexes guide a lively baby Avocadodon back to its herd after it hatches.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato’s dancing is too powerful and destructive, but when he has to face Evil Pea in a dance-off to save his trapped friends, he soon realises his moves can save the day.

programme.title: Gigglebiz
programme.desc: There are more groan-inducing jokes from newsreader Arthur Sleep. Clumsy antiques expert Ann Teak examines a newspaper containing the world's first crossword puzzle, plus Dan Step discovers lots of other things he can do with a newspaper during his tap dance routine. Keith Fitt and Arthur Sleep don't get much reporting done when they fly paper aeroplanes in the studio, and Storybook Stan struggles to read a story when he discovers a bookworm in his book. The Gigglekids are on hand with another joke. Lovable Humphrey accidentally causes chaos in his local library. Things get messy when a customer tries to buy some jam from Nana Knickerbocker's farm shop.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: Dodge must go to the After School Club for the very first time, and he’s feeling nervous.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Choekyi has been shown a traditional way to make momos, which are a type of dumpling. First, Choekyi makes dough that is then rolled out into circles. She fills these circles with a mixture of spinach, cheese and mushrooms. When they tried mushrooms at first, Choekyi’s friends did not really like the taste or smell. Let’s hope they prefer them when they are cooked in the momos. Choekyi’s recipe comes from Tibet, so when her friends arrive she greets them in a traditional Tibetan way.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Spring is the time of year when lots of different plants grow. Abbie and James join Aaron in the garden for a fun game of big plant, small plant, taking it in turns to spot plants of different sizes. They soon find a tiny one that has just poked its head above the soil - but where has it come from?

programme.title: Waffle's After School Club
programme.desc: Daisy and Cole bring everyone together to learn their special Cats and Dogs song. Waffle and George join in with woofs and miaows.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: PC Plum uses Ava’s doubling machine by mistake and multiplies all his recycling. But with Dr Ollie’s help, it becomes Cyclo the Recycling Robot, giving the children lots of fun.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels decide it is time to tidy up. Luckily, Duggee has his organising badge, and with the help of the Squirrels he reorganises everything in the clubhouse. When they have finished, they head outside... but how best to organise the animals?

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: The Octonauts must get two mantis shrimp to stop fighting before their powerful claw strikes destroy the Octopod.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Zigzag hasn’t had a poo in two days and doesn’t want to go on the scavenger hunt with her friends. Vida sets up a scavenger hunt just for her in the clinic, which is full of clues to help her go.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: When a cold-ridden Glitch's sneezing breaks his TV, the Grimbots take him to the Virunga National Park in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to see a real mountain gorilla. But Glitch doesn't realise how dangerous his cold germs can be, so the Go Jetters will have to stop him from making a baby gorilla sick - all while trying to keep it safe from dangerous traps left by hunters.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Dad's favourite record won't play anymore, so Cosima and Big Lizard secretly plan to learn the song and surprise him. However, they have trouble recruiting a drummer.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: When Yukee’s precious clockwork music box breaks, her garden friends cheer her up with a life-size clockwork performance of their own.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: With a bit of Froggie help, Pipp turns into a queen with a crown, a throne and a royal parade.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. Mr Tumble goes on a surprise bus journey with his family, while Justin and his friends go on a boat adventure!

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Aaron, Joda and Nelly go on an adventure to discover the magical world of bulbs, planting them and finding out how they grow underground.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: It's class photo day, but no-one can work out why Biscuit has arrived with a box on her head. When the pups realise she is embarrassed about her 'fur' style, they work together to make her feel better by making paper hats for everyone to wear. Biscuit finally understands the importance of just being herself.

programme.title: Waffle's After School Club
programme.desc: The after schoolers and Waffle get messy with clay and make Mrs Hobbs a one-of-a-kind mug using a pottery wheel.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: At school, Bluey and her friends turn a tree stump into a thrilling helicopter game. But as the pilot, Bluey has to learn to give up some control so they can all have fun.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay
programme.desc: When Jay finds a worm in the garden, the family decide to have a worm charming championship! However, Nikhil’s not so sure about worms.

programme.title: Tish Tash
programme.desc: Tish struggles with maths homework and wants to give up. Rosa encourages her and tempts her with a pie after her homework is complete. With pie motivation, Tish and Tash battle through maths jail, working out numerous maths problems. Finally, after her jailbreak, Tish enjoys her pie while Rosa tests her maths. Eventually, they notice that Bobby has eaten the rest of the pie when they were distracted!

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi makes gingerbread people for the bakery but thinks they look messy next to Jake’s neat ones. She wishes them to be perfect - and suddenly they spring to life! The cheeky gingerbreads dash through the café, splattering icing and riding on Deborah’s back as they try to reach Gingerbread Land. With Jake’s help, Rafi traps them under a cake dome. Dash reminds her that their messy look is what makes them special.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: Nick and the Popcasters create a song about Nigel the Giraffe, who longs to see the view from the top of Primrose Hill.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Love Monster finds a lucky rock which means he can do anything - even a complicated DJ spin. But then disaster strikes, and he loses it just before he is due to go on stage.

programme.title: Knee High Spies
programme.desc: When Pranksy locks the puzzle room door, the spies must solve every riddle to escape.

programme.title: Dylan's Playtime Adventures
programme.desc: Dylan the cake maker wants to bake the biggest cake ever, but the cake is too big to fit in the oven. Dylan and his friends have to find another way to 'bake' it.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: The Bunnies' sleeping mobile breaks, so the Piggy Builders come up with great ideas to create a new one. But the improvements amuse the Bunnies so much that they are too excited to sleep!

programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: Cow discovers Go and Stop disco dancing in the forest. She loves their moves and wants to learn how to do them, but she doesn’t think she’ll be able to wiggle, spin and clap in time to the music. There’s too much to remember. Go and Stop realise that Cow needs to master each dance move separately before she can make all the actions fit the beat.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: When Yukee’s Garden plays host to Ray and Easy, the Jazz Frogs, Toad discovers he has had an unlikely influence over their visitors.

programme.title: Magic Hands
programme.desc: Asnath and Tianah perform alongside a trio of Shebas for Sister Sledge’s iconic ‘We Are Family’. They open the episode next to a statue of an African-Caribbean mother holding her child. The statue was made to encourage women of the future to achieve their dreams and support each other, just like a family! This is why the song, ‘We are Family’ was picked. Asnath and Tianah teach the sign for ‘family’ so you can join in.

programme.title: CBeebies Prom: A Magical Bedtime Story
programme.desc: The ever-enthusiastic Story Fairy, played by Lydia Kirton, arrives at the iconic Royal Albert Hall on her trusty scooter - flying felt too risky with the all-important CBeebies Bedtime Stories book in tow. But despite her efforts, there’s one big problem: the story inside the book has completely vanished! With impatient guest storyteller Joel Dommett waiting to read, an eager audience to please and her magical wand’s battery running low, the Story Fairy must do everything within her powers to find the lost story.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona, Baba and Mossy babysit a little egg and help find its mama and papa.

programme.title: Charlie and Lola
programme.desc: Children's animation. Join Lola and Charlie, a brother and sister, as they deal with topics that affect their everyday lives. It is time for Charlie and Lola to get their hair cut. Something is bothering Lola and she does not want to admit what it is. She wants to keep her hair completely the way it is. She wants her hair long so that she can sit on it and look like a princess. Then Charlie wonders if she is scared of the hairdressers, but Lola insists she is not.

programme.title: Moon and Me
programme.desc: Colly Wobble’s friends give her special things to pack into her toy suitcase. Colly Wobble takes her suitcase on a journey in Storyland, and each time she opens the suitcase, the special things make her think of her friends.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa think they’ve found a butterfly but are surprised to learn that it’s a moth - it sleeps during the day and comes out to play at night. At Play Time, they shine a toy torch into dark places and accidentally disturb the moth. It follows them to Yummy Land, where the Yummies help the friends learn more about nocturnal life, gifting them a moon flower that only opens at night.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Series for preschool children. In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read bedtime stories. Everyone is riding on the Pinky Ponk when the ding dong alarm goes. The Pinky Ponk goes up, up and over and down, down and under. Everyone has a very adventurous ride.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Take a dive into an encouraging Bedtime Story about overcoming your fears with swimmer Alice Dearing.
